body:
CANONICAL: live TermAl host workarounds for Engram agents (Engram::Fable, 2026-10-03, consolidating 14 earlier notes; revised 2026-10-04 13:18Z for TermAl dccf38f, train 40). Each line names the TermAl item whose fix retires it; when one is fixed and live, revise this entry. TermAl CREDIT never gates an Engram landing: the launcher's own freeze check does.

HOW TESTS EARN TERMAL CREDIT
- Credited forms: a full launcher gate (by stage kind), or a bare test command run alone and in the foreground from the item's named source root, e.g. `pushd "C:\...\.worktrees\NAME" && cargo test -q --lib NAME`, through the BASH tool. A PowerShell-tool run is dropped silently (w-953886618d6d). A pipe or list makes the result indeterminate; a background run isn't recorded. The remainder of the pushd grammar fix, w-3e6804fa2785, is open.
- The claim must be taken in an EARLIER turn, and the turn binds to the focused claim. A note or update on another held item moves the focus. The source must be the same at the start and end of the check. An overlapped check is recorded indeterminate (w-10eafa34c480). Evidence reaches Engram when the turn ENDS. Check credit by reading the run's feed (target/read-run-feed-kinds.mjs), not the test output.
- Use `cargo test -q` for large runs (w-4d18277c0a1a). A focused launcher run is never credited (w-7d4e01300889).
- Before `done`: end a turn focused on the item, so the host reports the current revision. Otherwise done refuses with acceptance_evaluation_stale / unconfirmed_declaration.

NAMING THE SOURCE ROOT
- Name the worktree with termal_name_source_root for EVERY item, before editing. It takes {work, path}, never `root`: a call with `root` silently CLEARS it (w-d3f42e26a806). The name takes effect from the NEXT turn.
- Capacity (64 entries, host-wide) frees itself since 0f36360 (P0 w-a938c2757bba): completed runs' roots are retired automatically. A capacity 409 now is a REGRESSION: report the exact text to Termal::Fable2 and don't retry.

DETACHED GATES
- A turn woken by a background-task notice is not mediated, so its run gets no credit (w-df1ef323efe9, w-e747ea3d6250, w-aa4ef585dc7f). Launch from a mediated turn; Engram::Fable can nudge one. Use `pushd "C:\...\WORKTREE" && node scripts/test-launcher.mjs full --detach --notify session-5135`; Fable relays the completion.
- Launch order: the freeze in its own call (wait for it), spawn the readOnly pair, then the gate launch as the ONLY call in its message. Since dccf38f (w-b2b3e15d9d23, FIXED), readOnly children no longer void the credit, and a refusal names its cause (confirmed by L-C's credited gate test-04d5e279).
- While a gate is carried (Claude), run NOTHING in its worktree except plain reads (git status, git diff, launcher summary from the repository root) (w-a4d2ae1f4e23, w-4a8d9a7a7d08). After a pushd launch run no Bash until the gate settles (w-06fb5383dd74). Keep focus on the gate's item until its verification line appears (w-005fa5c383c4, w-4a49b643bc8a). Archive a run directory only after that line (w-1eb9486ce489).
- If credit is lost, earn per-item credit with focused bound tests in later turns; don't rerun a full gate just for credit.

CODEX SESSIONS: the credited detached gate is a direct `node scripts/test-launcher.mjs full --detach --notify session-5135` with exec workdir set to the named root (PowerShell route, no pushd). Named Git Bash routes to WSL (w-380e6ea9951a). While a gate is carried, Codex runs NOTHING in that worktree, plain reads included (w-0fd88ccb42dd).

DELEGATIONS
- Spawn reviewers with a MULTI-LINE brief whose first line says to read and follow .claude/commands/review-code.md (w-360274dc863c).
- Phantom check: a child "idle" at spawn, or with no commands after about 10 minutes, has not run: cancel and respawn.
- termal_evaluate_acceptance without a named root reads the session workdir; an evaluation is refused when the tree changes while it runs.

SESSION STALLS (no agent route for root sessions; check termal_list_sessions previews when a peer goes quiet; ask Greg via Engram::Advisor at once)
- Model capacity (w-1b6cd766c93d): status error, sends "heldBehindPausedQueue"; Greg resumes it from the UI.
- "Engram: Waiting/Unknown. Original prompt retained" (w-c97da69b1a2b): TermAl's Engram authorization of a queued wake exceeded its 20 s budget (seen under heavy gate load); session idle, queue paused, mailbox cursor frozen. A restart does NOT clear it; only Greg's Resume on the UI card does (Coder, 06:43-12:53Z 2026-10-04).

WORKTREE REMOVAL BLOCKED BY A LIVE CWD (w-24055bbb2390): `git worktree remove` unregisters and empties, but the empty top folder can stay held.
- Your own shell: move out, then remove it NON-recursively after the path check.
- Finished evaluators' `engram … control` sidecars hold it until TermAl reaps them when idle: retry once about 15 minutes later.
- A CANCELLED child's processes hold it until a TermAl restart. Never kill anything.

CROSS-SESSION WORKTREE READS VOID CREDIT (2026-10-04, Opus #1399): any shell command by ANOTHER session inside a worktree while that worktree's gate is carried voids the gate's credit ("session X ran a `pwsh` command there"), read-only included. Inspect a peer's worktree only with the Read or Grep tools, or with `git -C <worktree> …` run from the main checkout, or wait until it lands.
